name: The community circuit
description: A guided flight through Charlottesville’s gathering places. Pause at every stop, explore if you like, then continue when you’re ready.

stops.note: Our community home: a place to build, share, and follow a good idea.
The pedestrian heart of Charlottesville: central trees, side walking lanes, and local storefronts.
The open-air stage and chalk wall at the mall’s east end. Every show adds another story.
A seat at the table for First Wednesdays: no slides, just good conversations.
A school without walls, and a home for beCamp’s community-built agenda.
